race.description: Inland Petroleum Golden Eagle & Derby Day – Saturday 31 October Mdn Plate
race.comment: THE BEAST (7) ten-start Maiden who can get the better of these with the visors going on. Excellent return when he stalked the speed to finish a game second over 1100m at Narromine. Should tighten right up and expected to go close with the claim. YEAH BUDDY (8) gets the visors added today fourth up and shapes as a top-three contender. Turned in an out of character performance with the 3kg claimer aboard when sixth at Tamworth over 1200m. Bumped into a handy type two back and senior rider takes the reins. MELDIRER (10) improving mare who relished the jump in trip at her second race start with a game third over 1300m at Narromine. Can go on with it now and looks close to a win. FORWARDING (2) savaged the line from a rearward position to finish fourth over 1400m at this track. Can race much closer here from the rails draw and gets Stiff claim. Leading contender.
